methodology: Real Chrome headless, real ES modules, isolated storage, public UI/file import, Playwright clock for extraction, temporary loopback server closed after tests. No production state hooks.

results.name: anonymous home boots without login; initial local progress is valid
navigation opens real operations, loadout and supply workspaces
buying, selecting and equipping uses real persisted assets and money
settings persist and both destructive confirmation choices work
responsive home and operations fit laptop and tablet widths
factory deploy renders all four atlases and consumes the lobby reservation
Esc pause freezes countdown, opens confirmation, and abandonment returns to lobby
real imported-map search, protected inventory and successful extraction complete a full loop
protected loot survives a browser reload once; no stale carried gear returns
all 37 assets render transparently; valuable Emoji and optional artwork fallback remain usable
real sprint input updates stamina; a grenade defeat keeps only protected loot
map editor round trip preserves paid exits, ground loot and an explicit zero bot count
corrupt local progress shows a recoverable error without overwriting the save
normal user flows emit no JavaScript or console errors
